purpose: Teach: にもかかわらず/おっしゃら/あげれ/仰っ/当てはめ/まとまら/違わ/無き

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんは、苦境にもかかわらず誠実を貫いたぞ
lines.en: Your father kept his integrity, no matter what the crisis was.
lines.style: Measured and distant, the tone of someone recalling a fact they've held for decades. Slow cadence. Slight weight on 「誠実」—integrity—like it was a rare thing. No sentimentality, just respect.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは具体的におっしゃらないご美学がありました
lines.en: Yes. He had a principle about not spelling everything out explicitly.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. Respectful echo of the elder's tone. Voice firm but not defensive. A small nod in the delivery—acknowledging something difficult about the old man he understood.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんは、社員にもっと褒美をあげればと言ったぞ
lines.en: Your father used to say the staff deserved more recognition.
lines.style: Gentle reproach in the memory. Slower on this line—Hiroshi reflecting on something he didn't fully act on. A faint regret underneath, but not self-pitying. The tone of accepting an old criticism.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが仰った社訓、引き継いでおります
lines.en: Yes. The company principles he taught—I'm carrying them forward.
lines.style: Steady, almost formal. A promise being restated. Not defensive, but clear-eyed. The slight pause before 「引き継いでおります」 suggests he's aware of how much weight that carries.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんは、海外事例を当てはめての戦略がお得意だった
lines.en: He was gifted at taking overseas cases and applying them strategically.
lines.style: Admiring, almost surprised by the memory. Slight lift on 「お得意」—his father's strength. The pace picks up slightly, like recalling something impressive. Warm underneath the reflection.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは意見がまとまらない会議を嫌った
lines.en: Yes. He hated meetings where people couldn't reach agreement.
lines.style: A dry acknowledgment. Almost wry—the ghost of a smile in the voice. Hiroshi recognizing his father's impatience as something he may have inherited. Even and matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんは、約束は契約書と違わないとお考えだった
lines.en: He believed a promise held the same weight as a signed contract.
lines.style: Slow, deliberate. Each phrase carries weight. This is the core of who the father was. No rush. Faint echo of admiration and the loneliness of trying to live up to it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さん無きの会社、私が支えます
lines.en: Yes. Without him, I'm bearing the weight of this company now.
lines.style: Quiet finality. The closing line—acceptance without drama. Steady, almost formal. Not tired, but carrying something. The end of the conversation in the voice. A man stepping into a role that was always meant for him.
